title: First halting configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. If the configuration reached after $t$ steps is halted, then there is a step $u \le t$ such that no configuration reached in fewer than $u$ steps is halted, and the configuration at step $u$ equals the configuration at step $t$.
hypotheses_covered: The configuration reached after $t$ steps is halted
